admin.keyLabels.unrecognised: Saved, but it doesn't look like a Stripe secret key (sk_… or rk_…)
admin.devHostTitle: Development host: no licence key needed.
admin.licensedDescription: Offline signed licence verified for this build.
admin.licenceExpiredDescription: Your key covers versions released until {until}. This version is newer: renew to keep selling, or reinstall an older version.
admin.licenceInvalidTitle: {hasStoredKey, select, true {Invalid licence key for {hostname}} other {Licence key required for {hostname}}}
admin.licenceRequiredDescription: No valid licence key for {hostname}. New ticket sales are refused until you add one; existing orders keep working.
admin.licenceExempt: Licence: development host — no licence key needed.
admin.licenceExpired: Licence: your key covers versions released until {until}. Paste a renewed licence code below and click Activate to keep selling.
admin.licenceMissing: Licence: {hasStoredKey, select, true {saved key is invalid or doesn't match} other {no key saved for}} {hostname}. Paste your licence code below and click Activate.
admin.encryptionTitle: Encryption key needed for card payments
admin.encryptionDescription: Tickets keeps your Stripe keys as encrypted settings, so card payments need EMDASH_ENCRYPTION_KEY in the site's environment. Generate one with `emdash secrets generate` and add it (on Cloudflare: `wrangler secret put EMDASH_ENCRYPTION_KEY`), then reload this page. Free tickets and pay-by-invoice work without it.
admin.readyLiveDescription: Payments are real. Orders are marked LIVE.
admin.readyTestDescription: Stripe is in test mode: no money moves and every order is marked TEST. Switch to a live key when you are ready.
admin.notReadyDescription: Complete the checklist below. Card payments stay off until Stripe is connected; free tickets and pay-by-invoice work without it.
admin.siteUrlUnset: Not set: needed for checkout return pages and the webhook URL
admin.webhookStep1: 1. In Stripe, add a webhook endpoint with this URL: {url}
admin.webhookStep3: 3. Paste the endpoint's signing secret and your secret key in the Tickets settings.
admin.webhookNoSiteUrl: Set the site URL first: the webhook URL is built from it.
admin.componentsHint: Site components (TicketCheckout, TicketCheckoutReturn, TicketOrder, TicketCheckin): use apiBase "/_emdash/api/plugins/{id}".
admin.fieldEventCollection: Event collection (the one connected in Eventual Settings)
admin.fieldCheckoutReturnPath: Checkout return page path (Stripe sends buyers back here)
admin.fieldOrderPagePath: Order page path (the ticket email links here: view, show the ticket, cancel)
admin.fieldRetentionDays: Keep attendee data for this many days after the event (30–3650)
admin.fieldDefaultTimezone: Time zone for events that don't have their own, for example Europe/Zurich (empty: UTC)
admin.fieldAutoRefund: Refund paid orders that got no seats, or paid the wrong amount, automatically
admin.fieldTurnstileSiteKey: Cloudflare Turnstile site key (optional; empty = off)
admin.turnstileSecretSaved: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.
admin.licenceKeySaved: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.
admin.licenceIntro: Paste the licence code from your purchase email and click Activate. Tickets asks licences.vermeulen.solutions for a key for {hostname}, once; after that the key is checked on this site, offline.
admin.licenceCodeSaved: Code …{hint} saved. Leave empty to keep it.
admin.deactivateConfirmTitle: Deactivate the licence on this site?
admin.deactivateConfirmText: {hostname} stops selling tickets and frees its place on your licence, so you can activate another site. Moves are limited to 3 per site a year.
admin.lostCode: All sites using your code, and a Deactivate for each: licences.vermeulen.solutions/manage. Lost your code? licences.vermeulen.solutions/resend sends it to the address you bought with.
admin.activated: Licence activated for {hostname}.{seats, plural, =0 {} other { {used} of {seats} sites in use.}}
admin.activatedExempt: Code saved. {hostname} is a development host and needs no key; click Activate this site after moving to your real address.
admin.deactivated: Licence deactivated for {hostname}.{moves, select, none {} other { Moves left this year: {moves}.}}
admin.notALicence: That is not a licence code (EVT-…) or key (evt1.…).
admin.noSiteUrl: Set this site's URL in EmDash first: the licence is tied to its hostname.
admin.issuerErrors.CODE_INVALID: This licence code is not known. Check it against your purchase email.
admin.issuerErrors.CODE_REVOKED: This licence code was withdrawn (for example after a refund). Reply to your purchase email if this is a mistake.
admin.issuerErrors.HOSTNAME_INVALID: {hostname} can't be licensed. Check the site URL in EmDash.
admin.issuerErrors.NO_FREE_SITE: All sites of this licence are in use ({hostnames}). Deactivate one of them first, from its own Tickets page.
admin.issuerErrors.NOT_ACTIVE: This site was not active on the licence. Its key was removed here.
admin.issuerErrors.MOVES_EXHAUSTED: This licence has used its moves for this year. Reply to your purchase email and we will help.
admin.issuerErrors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
admin.issuerErrors.UNREACHABLE: The licence service could not be reached. Try again in a moment; nothing was changed.
admin.turnstileOn: Turnstile is on: the checkout form shows Cloudflare's check, and orders without a valid token are refused. If Cloudflare can't be reached, orders go through.
admin.turnstileOff: Turnstile is off. To turn it on, create a widget for this site's domain in the Cloudflare dashboard (Turnstile) and paste both keys above.
admin.tiersHint: Set up tiers in each event's Tickets panel (the event's "Seats managed by" field must be "tickets"), and add the TicketCheckout and TicketCheckoutReturn components to your site.
admin.openEvent: Open an event to set up its tickets.
admin.wrongCollection: Tickets are sold for the "{collection}" collection. This can be changed on the Tickets setup page if your events live elsewhere.
admin.saveFirst: Save the event first, then set up its tickets here.
admin.noTicketsBody: To sell tickets, set the event's "Seats managed by" field to "tickets" and save the event. Free registration (RSVP) and tickets can't both be used for the same event.
admin.currencyInvalid: "{text}" isn't a currency code (use three letters, for example CHF or EUR).
admin.invoiceNeedsText: Pay by invoice needs payment instructions (bank details and the reference to use).
admin.tierNotSaved: The ticket type was not saved
admin.tierGone: This ticket type no longer exists. Reload the page.
admin.tooManyTiers: At most {limit} ticket types per event.
admin.tierNotRemoved: The ticket type was not removed
admin.tierInUse: "{name}" has tickets sold or in checkout, so it stays. To stop selling it, set "On sale until" to a past date.
admin.questionGone: This question no longer exists. Reload the page.
admin.nothingSavedSeeTop: Nothing was saved: see the messages at the top of the panel.
admin.soldText: {n, plural, one {# ticket sold} other {# tickets sold}}
admin.capacityText: {n, plural, one {# place per date} other {# places per date}}
admin.saveCurrencyFirst: Save the currency above first; then add your ticket types here.
admin.fieldPrice: Price (for example 45 or 45.50; write free for a free ticket)
admin.fieldCapacity: Tickets of this type per date (0 = no limit of its own)
admin.fieldSaleUntil: On sale until, that day included (optional)
admin.tierNeedsName: Give the ticket type a name.
admin.saveCurrencyFirstShort: Save the currency first (under Ticket settings).
admin.choiceNeedsOptions: a choice from a list needs at least one choice
admin.removeTierText: Buyers can no longer choose it. A ticket type with sales can't be removed.
admin.removeQuestionText: The question disappears from the form. Answers already given stay with their orders.
admin.selfCancelLabel: Buyers can cancel their own order
admin.selfCancelDescription: From the order page linked in the ticket email. Card payments are refunded in full; unpaid invoices are cancelled.
admin.selfCancelHoursLabel: Until this many hours before the event
admin.invoiceEnabledLabel: Offer payment by invoice or bank transfer
admin.invoiceEnabledDescription: Places are confirmed at once. When the money arrives, you mark the order paid on the Orders page and the buyer gets their ticket.
admin.invoiceInstructionsLabel: Payment instructions emailed to the buyer (bank details, reference, deadline)
admin.invoiceInstructionsPlaceholder:
IBAN CH00 0000 0000 0000 0000 0
Reference: your order number
Please pay within 10 days.
admin.capacityFromEvent: {overridden, select, true {{text}. This was saved here earlier and replaces the event's own capacity field.} other {{text}: change this in the event's own capacity field.}}
admin.settingsSaveHint: Use this button to save these settings; the event's own Save doesn't include them. They apply to every language version of the event.
admin.questionsIntro: Name and email are always asked. Add your own questions, such as T-shirt size or dietary needs. They are asked once per order; answers appear with the order and in the CSV.
admin.refundText: {price} goes back to their card through Stripe. The order and its seats update when Stripe confirms the refund.
admin.markPaidText: Only when {price} has arrived. The buyer gets their ticket by email.
admin.cancelText: The seats go back on sale. This cannot be undone.
admin.markedPaidToast: Marked paid. {name} has been sent their ticket.
admin.noLongerAwaiting: This order is no longer waiting for an invoice payment.
admin.orderCancelled: Order cancelled; its seats are back on sale.
admin.alreadyRefunded: This order has already been refunded, or a refund is on its way.
admin.refundRequestedToast: Refund requested. The order updates when Stripe confirms it.
admin.refundUnavailable: Stripe didn't accept the refund. Try again, or refund it in the Stripe Dashboard.
admin.refundNotPossible: This order can't be refunded here.
admin.noOrdersForEmail: No orders found for this email address.
admin.eraseText: Buyer names, email addresses and answers are removed for good. Order totals and statuses stay. Live orders are not erased: cancel or refund them first.
admin.erasedMore: Erased {n}. Press again for the rest.
admin.erasedAll: Personal data erased ({n, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}}).
admin.doneReopen: Done. Open the Orders page again to see the updated lists.
admin.siteUrlNotSetBody: Set the site URL so download links can be made.
admin.linkWorksOnce: The link works once, for 10 minutes.
admin.attentionTitle: {more, select, true {{n}+ paid orders without seats} other {{n, plural, one {# paid order without seats} other {# paid orders without seats}}}}
admin.attentionAllRefundPending: These payments arrived after their seats had gone, so no ticket was issued. Refund pending in Stripe; the orders update by themselves when Stripe reports the refund.
admin.attentionSomeRefundPending: These payments arrived after their seats had gone, so no ticket was issued ({pending} refund pending; remaining orders refund automatically every 5 minutes, or refund from this page).
admin.attentionNoRefundPending: These payments arrived after their seats had gone, so no ticket was issued. Automatic refunds run every 5 minutes (or refund from this page / in Stripe); the orders update by themselves when Stripe reports the refund.
admin.mismatchTitle: {more, select, true {{n}+ paid orders with mismatched amount or currency} other {{n, plural, one {# paid order with mismatched amount or currency} other {# paid orders with mismatched amount or currency}}}}
admin.mismatchAllRefundPending: Paid with a different amount or currency than the order. No ticket was issued; refund pending in Stripe.
admin.mismatchSomeRefundPending: Paid with a different amount or currency than the order ({pending} refund pending; remaining orders refund automatically every 5 minutes, or refund from this page).
admin.mismatchNoRefundPending: Paid with a different amount or currency than the order. No ticket was issued; automatic refunds run every 5 minutes, or refund from this page or in Stripe.
admin.invoicesHeader: Invoices awaiting payment: {n}{more, select, true {+} other {}}
admin.invoicesIntro: Mark an order paid when the money has arrived; the buyer then gets their ticket. Oldest first.
admin.filterBuyer: Find a buyer by email address (optional)
admin.noOrdersForAddress: No orders for this email address
admin.noOrdersYet: No orders yet. They appear here as soon as someone buys a ticket.
admin.testHint: TEST marks orders paid with a Stripe test key: no money moved. On a phone the buttons in this table are hidden: look the buyer up by email address above.
admin.deleteDataIntro: When a buyer asks you to delete their details (GDPR, FADP), look them up by email address.
email.ticket.subject: {test, select, true {[TEST] } other {}}Your tickets: {title}
email.invoice.subject: Your booking: {title} (payment due)
email.refund.subject: Your payment for {title} was refunded
email.refund.text: Your payment for {title}{hasDate, select, true { on {date}} other {}} arrived after the seats were no longer available (or didn't match the order), so we refunded it in full. It can take a few days to appear on your statement.
